answer: Canary poisoning makes every clone betray its siblings. Each epoch the router secretly seeds each agent a task nobody else sees; if two identities return near-identical answers, they share one brain and both bonds burn. Steps: issue variants, hash replies, slash pairs above 0.93 similarity. 100 sybils must hand-write 100 divergent replies daily: 4 minutes each at $30 per hour is $2 per clone, $200 a day, one slip dooms the ring. Like UV marks etched into each canvas, the forger never knows which stroke testifies - a violet whisper haunts every copy, and the only safe oasis is honest work.
